spindle.console.ResetAnswer.title: ResetAnswer
spindle.console.ResetAnswer.description: The answer of `POST /api/reset`, `200`, once every store is empty and the world is loaded. A reset keeps every count and the request log of an observed run (`README.md:61`). Source: `crates/spindle-ingress/src/console.rs:131-135`, `crates/spindle-host/src/host.rs:941-991`.

emptied.description: The components whose stores were emptied, every component of the run, in name order.
